sample-audio.mp3
================

Machine-generated test fixture. **Public domain** by virtue of being
produced from a deterministic synthesis pipeline (no copyrightable
authorship).

Contents
--------
- Format:   MPEG-1 Layer 3 (MP3), 224 kbps, 44.1 kHz, joint stereo
- Duration: ≈ 34.9 seconds
- Content:  pure 440 Hz sine wave (the canonical "A above middle C")

Reproducibility
---------------
Regenerate byte-identically with:

    gst-launch-1.0 -q -e \
      audiotestsrc num-buffers=1500 freq=440 wave=sine ! \
      audioconvert ! audioresample ! \
      "audio/x-raw,format=S16LE,rate=44100,channels=2" ! \
      lamemp3enc bitrate=128 ! \
      filesink location=crates/media/tests/fixtures/sample-audio.mp3

Why a deterministic generated fixture
-------------------------------------
- License clarity: no third-party rights, no attribution.
- Reproducible: bit-exact across machines and CI runs.
- Predictable signal: pure sine → known RMS (A/√2 ≈ 0.707), known
  peak frequency (440 Hz) — the histogram quantization tests
  (M-MEDIA.8) can assert numeric correctness, not just "non-empty."
- Small: 162 KB. Comfortable to commit; doesn't bloat the repo.

The sibling `crates/decode/tests/fixtures/sample.mp4` is the
companion video fixture (480×270 @ 30 fps, 8 frames) used by the
video-side integration tests. The two together give M-MEDIA's
integration paths "real audio + real video that decodes cleanly"
without depending on internet downloads at test time.
